description: Surfaces today's file exceptions before you go looking — the late Loan Estimate, the missing ESIGN consent, and the dissatisfaction phrase in a call — each with the member file number, the rule at issue, and a severity flag.

Opens a single member file and assembles its timeline across MeridianLink, the core, and the contact center — attributes, disclosure dates, interactions, and trigger words — so you do not export and cross-reference by hand.

Compares the file to your documented procedure, marks each deviation, and shows the pattern behind it — late Loan Estimates clustering on manual branch intake — so a one-off fix becomes a process fix.
Builds the member-specific disclosure checklist and calendar for the file, flags the late item for a documented cure, and plots the remaining milestones on their required dates.

Logs the interaction as a complaint under the CFPB definition — categorized, linked to the member and file, with the transcript excerpt attached — from flag to logged complaint in one step, with no separate form.
